title: "ALL THAT GLITTERS": APPROACHES TO EVALUATIONS WITH UNRELIABLE MODEL AND HUMAN ANNOTATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Using a Hierarchical Rater Model (HRM) combining Item Response Theory (IRT) and Signal Detection Theory (SDT) to isolate and measure standardized differences in rater severity and leniency between Black and White teachers.
Evaluating the degradation of model rating centrality and accuracy when processing classroom transcripts containing African-American English (AAE) versus Standard American English.

Applying Signal Detection Theory (SDT) within an MCMC-estimated Hierarchical Rater Model to disentangle individual human and model rater behaviors (e.g., systematic severity or leniency) from the true latent scores of the instructional observations.
